state.goal: Research AWS fit and current baseline pricing for a modern AI SaaS architecture

found.text:
AWS Lambda Functions charges $0.20 per million requests and bills compute by execution duration in GB-seconds. The monthly free tier includes 1 million requests and 400,000 GB-seconds of compute. Actual compute rates vary by region and configuration; see AWS’s pricing page for current rates and details. ([aws.amazon.com](https://aws.amazon.com/lambda/pricing/))
Sources:
[s1] AWS Lambda Pricing — https://aws.amazon.com/lambda/pricing/

AWS’s RDS for PostgreSQL pricing page: ([aws.amazon.com](https://aws.amazon.com/rds/postgresql/pricing/))

The db.t4g.micro hourly price depends on AWS Region and deployment type. T4g instances may also incur CPU-credit charges if average CPU use exceeds baseline.
Sources:
[s2] Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL Pricing — https://aws.amazon.com/rds/postgresql/pricing/
